reply_text:
I found no dated AI predictions by Satya Nadella from 2015. The three fixed searches returned only coverage from 2023–2026. The four searches I added for named 2015 events and the six pages I opened held nothing that meets all four tests.

**What the 2015 pages held**
- **Convergence keynote (16 March 2015, Microsoft's transcript):** he says machine learning is "an emerging technology that I believe fundamentally is going to change a lot of business processes." It looks forward but gives no date or span, and it isn't about when AGI arrives, so it doesn't go under undated either. The page text I received cut off partway through the speech, so I didn't read the end.
- **Shareholder letter (signed 19 October 2015):** the only dated goals are for fiscal 2018: $20 billion a year in commercial cloud revenue and 1 billion Windows 10 devices. Those are business forecasts, so I left them out. Nothing about AI in the letter has a date.
- **Build (29 April 2015):** Microsoft's "Part 1" transcript is a short opening that talks about the "intelligent cloud" and making machine learning widely available. It has no dates. I didn't open the later parts.
- **Worldwide Partner Conference (13 July 2015):** Microsoft's transcript cut off during a product demo. The part I read has no dated AI claim.
- **Dreamforce (September 2015):** I only had Paul Thurrott's news write-up, which covers Windows phones and makes no AI prediction.
- **Neowin "Cortana beyond the OS" article:** this turned out to be about Build 2016, not 2015, so it goes under other_years.

**Limits of this search**
- I used all 6 page openings and 10 of the 12 searches. I left the last two unused because I couldn't open any more pages to quote from.
- I didn't open Nadella's June 2015 email to staff, his November 2015 India visit, the rest of the Build transcript or the Dreamforce recording.
- A few searches were thrown off by Python errors in my own code. No search was run twice.
